# RAR fixtures

These files are byte-identical to `data/` in the `unrar` 0.5.8 crate
(<https://crates.io/crates/unrar/0.5.8>), redistributed under its MIT option;
see [LICENSE-MIT](LICENSE-MIT).

| Local file | Upstream file | Password |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version.rar` | `version.rar` | none |
| `unicode.rar` | `unicode.rar` | none |
| `encrypted.rar` | `crypted.rar` | `unrar` |
| `comment-hpw-password.rar` | `comment-hpw-password.rar` | `password` |

The native decoder has a separate restricted license documented in
[third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md#unrar).
